directive.thread_id: film repository port 2026-11-05, lane film-tools (films-a): the motion-film format's soundtrack premix and icon writer
directive.quote: Finish the port of the film repository so it can be retired: move each job to its correct home, porting the correct parts one to one and never rebuilding from scratch what already worked; move the code byte for byte, then make what it fixed arguments and settings.

targets.baseline_commit_message: motion-film-template: a film's soundtrack premix and icon writer, moved byte for byte

preserve: each icon read from lucide-react's dist/esm/icons/<name>.mjs, its __iconNode array literal evaluated, the React key dropped
the file written as a first comment line then window.ICONS=<json>; byte-identical to the film's icons.js for its names, note and by
the lucide-react package of the checkout TRILLION_CHECKOUT names, when no icons_dir is given
allowed_deltas: the icon names, the icons folder, the output path and the first line's words are request fields (the names are the film's settings row)
one JSON answer as the last line instead of the "icons:" log line; without out the text is answered
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash).
